arguments.name: constraints
arguments.defaultValue: Generated sheets only (D65/D66), pure black field, five flat roles with identity pigments pinned, pale contour, clean-up standard (D72); variants must sit between the board cards cited and the existing cast. The owner's pick then gets a model sheet (showcase_model_sheet) before any key sheet; nothing is animated by generation (D68).
arguments.description: The style envelope the variants must stay inside.

Between-iteration muse for one showcase asset: design_muse on the board and the existing cast, then 3+ generated sheets side by side in the substrate, then a rubric grade. No asset enters a scene without it (D55); the pick proceeds to a model sheet (D72).
